growth_contract: Previous V2 borrowed lists expire at next begin attempt, including allocation-failed growth. Replaced command/background blocks freed before allocating successors; no new active frame/mode or input consumption on failure. A failed growth can change retained capacity, remains usable on retry, and never resets numeric-frame invalidity; only admitted begin does.

storage_accounting.formula: C=min(config.max_commands,16384,support.max_commands,command_bytes/sizeof(command_v2)); B=min(config.max_elements,4096,support.max_backgrounds); M=align_up(max_elements*sizeof(uint32_t),alignof(owner)); one background block M+B*sizeof(owner)<=background_bytes. Checked division before products and padding before sums. Both payload blocks <=16MiB each, freed before growth replacement; peak extra payload <=32MiB plus fixed control record/allocator overhead, not process RSS.
storage_accounting.default4096_node_example_B128: M16384 +128*76 =26112 bytes, command storage separate; support.max_backgrounds limits record count rather than always allocating4096 records.
